reason: The plugin enhances DeepSeek Harness subagent and subagent_fork tools with per-call model and reasoning-effort selection, child-session orchestration, execution-mode controls, and model discovery.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用提供逐次模型与推理强度选择，并支持子会话编排、前后台执行和模型发现。
summaries.en: Adds per-call model and reasoning-effort selection to DeepSeek Harness subagent tools, with child-session orchestration, foreground or background execution, and model discovery.

capabilities: Creates and manages subagent and forked child sessions
Selects models and reasoning effort per task
Supports foreground, background, continuable, and one-shot execution
Lists available models and supported reasoning efforts
